content: Letters 41 and 42, both to Ṣadr Jalāl al-Dīn Luṭf Allāh (chief ṣadr under Shāhrukh, d. 842/1439, per MK's footnote): a brief letter expressing regard for the chief ṣadr, whom Ibn Turka calls sulṭān al-ʿulamāʾ (no. 41), and a brief letter of well-wishing (no. 42) (TMN/MS p. 31, TMN/D pp. 211-12).
